title: a bid with adm explicitly null (and no nurl) is flagged payload_missing and shown as empty
specRef: https://github.com/InteractiveAdvertisingBureau/openrtb2.x/blob/403cbba542de3a5d9cfcccd0a34e74b01b79a9f1/2.6.md#objectbid — Bid.adm or Bid.nurl is required to deliver a creative; packages/core/rules-response.js already fires response.bid.payload_missing (WARNING) whenever both are absent, and null fails the same isStr() presence check as undefined.

preview.limitation: adm is null; there is no ad markup for the preview to render

specNotes: public/ortbtools.app.js setAdPreview() checks `if (!adm)` before any classification and renders the dedicated preview-empty state (t('preview.no_adm')) for any falsy adm, null included — this mirrors the already-verified pop-x-nurl-only-response.json preview shape.
